approvedConventions.decision: User-approved level-tier random policy: at generation, snapshot current player level when entering round preparation (or first in-round equip if not yet generated). Levels1–6 draw one completed item uniformly from35 ordinary completed items excluding Thief’s Gloves and one component uniformly from8 ordinary components. Level>=7 draws two distinct completed items uniformly without replacement from the same35-item pool. Sort each pool by apiName and use explicit seeded lcg32-v1. No duplicate apiName within the pair. Keep raw holder stats20 percentage-point crit chance (=2000Bps) and150 health. Temporary children cannot be sold, combined or returned as permanent inventory. Historical designer-level-pool statement was reported by user and not independently verified; neither threshold7 nor these weights are official evidence.
approvedConventions.decisionZh: 用户已批准等级分档项目方案：进入每轮准备期生成时取当前玩家等级（当轮首次穿戴且尚未生成时取当时等级）；1—6级从35件普通成装（排除窃贼）等概率抽1件，再从8普通散件等概率抽1件；7级及以上从同一35件成装池等概率无放回抽2件，两件apiName不重复。各池按apiName排序，使用显式种子的lcg32-v1。窃贼本体按英文客户端保留20%暴击率、150生命；临时件不能出售、合成或永久返还。用户提及早期设计师等级强度组合池说明尚未独立核验，7级分界和具体池权重均为项目约定，不称官方规则。
